about.title: About Gift Tax Calculator - Estate Planning Tax Tool
about.description: The Gift Tax Calculator is a comprehensive estate planning tool designed to help you calculate federal gift taxes and understand gift tax implications for wealth transfer strategies. Whether you're planning annual gifts, lifetime transfers, or estate planning strategies, this calculator provides accurate tax calculations based on current IRS gift tax rates and exemptions. Understanding gift tax calculations is essential for effective estate planning and minimizing tax liabilities on wealth transfers.

howTo.title: How to Use the Gift Tax Calculator

steps.title: Gift Amount
steps.description: Enter the total value of gifts you plan to give to each recipient during the tax year.

steps.title: Annual Exclusion
steps.description: The calculator applies the current annual gift tax exclusion ($17,000 for 2023, $18,000 for 2024).

steps.title: Recipient Information
steps.description: Specify the number of recipients and relationship (spouse, children, etc.) for accurate calculations.

steps.title: Lifetime Exemption
steps.description: Factor in your remaining lifetime gift and estate tax exemption amount.

steps.title: Previous Gifts
steps.description: Include any previous taxable gifts made to the same recipients in prior years.

steps.title: Calculate Tax Liability
steps.description: Review gift tax owed, exemption usage, and optimal gift timing strategies.

tips: Use annual exclusion amounts to gift tax-free each year

faq.q: What is the annual gift tax exclusion for 2024?
faq.a: The annual gift tax exclusion for 2024 is $18,000 per recipient ($36,000 for married couples using gift splitting). You can give this amount to unlimited recipients without using your lifetime exemption or paying gift tax.

faq.q: Do I need to file a gift tax return?
faq.a: You must file Form 709 if you give more than the annual exclusion to any person, make a gift of future interest, or elect gift splitting with your spouse. Filing is required even if no tax is owed due to lifetime exemption usage.

faq.q: What is the lifetime gift tax exemption?
faq.a: The lifetime gift and estate tax exemption for 2024 is $13.61 million per person ($27.22 million for married couples). Gifts exceeding annual exclusions reduce this lifetime exemption before triggering gift tax.

faq.q: Can I give unlimited gifts to my spouse?
faq.a: US citizens can make unlimited gifts to US citizen spouses without gift tax. For non-citizen spouses, the annual exclusion is higher ($185,000 in 2024) but unlimited marital deduction doesn't apply.
